mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 2.5% over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, which raises discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 5% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in INDPRO below its 12-month moving average by more than 3% for four consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production, which signals deteriorating economic activity and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12M MA by >3% for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both GDPC1 and HOUST for two consecutive quarters indicates weakening housing and overall demand, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline for 2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp cut in FEDFUNDS by more than 0.75 percentage points within a month, followed by a rise in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% in the next month, signals a delayed inflation response to easing, which ultimately boosts equity valuations via lower real rates over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS drops >0.75pp in one month AND CPIAUCSL > 2.5% next month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 55% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in PAYEMS above its 12-month moving average by more than 1% for three consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 12M MA by >1% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in RSAFS above its 12-month moving average by more than 5% for four consecutive months signals increased household savings and reduced consumption, which depresses corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 12M MA by >5% for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 50% of triggered episodes.
